articles.title: Lightning from Above
articles.summary: NASA astronaut Nichole Ayers captured this image of lightning while orbiting aboard the International Space Station more than 250 miles above Milan, Italy on July 1, 2025. articles.title: Star like early galaxies challenge views of cosmic evolution
articles.summary:

Scientists at the University of Missouri have identified a small group of unusual objects in the early universe that look like stars in images yet behave like compact galaxies when analyzed in detail.
